body: Independent read-only Codex review (high confidence) approved the four source/test paths against fixed branch base b167fe0a76a2e77d262f9f556c69ba6b9f118bbe. Literal profile parsing, selectors, cwd discrimination, minimum matching PID, adjacent expected pairs, exits0/2/3/4 and per-name/type boundary grouping follow the task. Seven additional stub-only cases passed, including exact profile key, review profile, absolute Node wrapper and non-executable probe. No finding. No live process/CI or full-suite rerun, repository edit or ref update by reviewer. Parent full requested suite12 tests passes. Verdict: correct.

P2 profile-name-grammar: generator-valid underscores were rejected by the identity parser. Addressed by adding underscore to the existing profile character class and one my_profile regression subcase. Regression failed before the fix, then full12 tests passed. Independent C50 review approved at high confidence with no additional finding; three extra stub cases passed, including Codex my_profile and rejection of leading underscore.

Independent read-only Codex C50 review against274257172db0915df34e9f1764c69f572346727f approved the one-character grammar change and seven-line regression subcase, high confidence, no additional finding. Source hashes match parent-tested bytes. Transcript SHA256 d61a817387b6966b27b4a10c8f6ff10527b32227482e26c2fc3ff6443184709a is pasted verbatim in validation.md. Verdict: correct.

P2 process-visibility: failed or empty ps/lsof probes falsely became unlaunched. The explicit second C50 check is addressed by capturing ps status/snapshot, requiring a numeric process line, and skipping4 on failed/empty cwd lookup, with one diagnostic. Four subcases failed before the fix, then full12 tests passed16.258s. Independent review approved the narrowed delta and8 extra stub cases. Nonempty namespace filtering remains indistinguishable from real absence; no host-visibility closure is claimed.

Independent read-only Codex review againstbfae75c14f52ff1b8083a69179bd90e91aa99458 approved the authorized probe failure/empty-output delta, high confidence, no additional finding. Source hashes match parent-tested bytes. Transcript SHA25654768faec91b016680275bc472010ca569c69256bb7f104c9a0a6b8346f1c23e is pasted verbatim in validation.md. Explicit residual: nonempty sandbox PID namespace may hide host workers. Verdict: correct.

P2 process-visibility occurrence2: uninspectable decoy cwd immediately skipped before a later visible worker. The amended C50 now saves the first cwd failure diagnostic, continues selection, compares a successfully inspected matching worker, and returns unknown4 only without any match plus a failed lookup. Three regression subcases failed before fix; full12 passes16.254s,27 seat subcases. Independent review approved with8 additional stub cases, no new finding.

Independent read-only Codex third C50 review againsta428eb5ff31dc8452e22fbea332efa2a5ee9a5e8 approved the amended cwd scan semantics, high confidence, no additional finding. First diagnostic retention, visible matching/differing worker precedence, inspected absence, and minimum visible matching PID all verified. Transcript SHA256621973453945c203a4c3d4c44d37eb87844cac94d8f637104d7e3c7510241035 pasted in validation.md. Nonempty hidden namespace limitation remains. Verdict: correct.

P2 duplicate-managed-flags occurrence1: the probe accepted an expected pair plus a conflicting occurrence. Addressed by aggregating every occurrence and locking any conflict to differs. Identical duplicates remain accepted; each managed name is rendered once. Both conflicting orders and both runtimes verified by the security reviewer; parent full12 tests passes15.667s,34 seat subcases.

P2 argv-diagnostic-disclosure occurrence1: mismatch output copied positional/private process text. Under explicit04:35:12Z refinement, found now projects only expected managed flag names and fixed ok/differs/missing markers, never observed values. Probe stderr uses fixed descriptions/status only. Synthetic positional, unmanaged and managed-looking private markers are absent from stdout+stderr. Flattened matching ambiguity remains separate and explicitly reported.

Existing seat module and14 extra synthetic fixture cases passed, covering both runtimes, duplicate orders, identical duplicates, missing/trailing values, marker absence and observed name ordering.
